ACTION_HUD.shoveHint: Target one creature with T. The target can be no more than one size larger than you. Shove follows the active D&D 5e Rules Version.
ACTION_HUD.shoveOutcomePrompt: Choose what you will do if the Shove against {target} succeeds.
ACTION_HUD.shoveRequiresCombat: Shove can only be used during combat.
ACTION_HUD.shoveTargetOutOfRange: Shove requires the targeted creature to be within 5 feet.
ACTION_HUD.shoveTargetTooLarge: You cannot Shove a creature more than one size larger than you.
ACTION_HUD.cannotShoveSelf: You cannot Shove yourself. Target another creature with T.
ACTION_HUD.shoveResolution: Resolve the contested check against {target}’s Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics). If your Athletics check beats the target’s check, the target is {outcome}. Apply the movement or Prone condition manually.
ACTION_HUD.shoveHint2014: 2014 rules: target one creature with T within your reach. It can be no more than one size larger. Roll Strength (Athletics), contested by the target’s choice of Athletics or Acrobatics; on success, push it 5 feet or knock it prone.
ACTION_HUD.shoveHint2024: 2024 rules: target one creature with T within 5 feet. It can be no more than one size larger. The target chooses a Strength or Dexterity save against DC 8 + your Strength modifier + proficiency bonus (a 2024 Monk with Martial Arts can use Dexterity instead). On a failed save, the selected Push or Prone effect is applied automatically.
ACTION_HUD.shoveTargetOutOfReach: Shove requires the targeted creature to be within your reach.
ACTION_HUD.shoveResolution2014: Resolve a contested check against {target}’s Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics); the target chooses. If your Strength (Athletics) check beats the target’s check, the target is {outcome}. Apply the movement or Prone condition manually.
ACTION_HUD.shoveResolution2024: {target} must make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw (the target chooses) against DC {dc}. Your Shove DC uses your {ability} modifier and proficiency bonus. On a failed save, the target is {outcome}.
ACTION_HUD.shoveOutcomePrompt2014: Choose the effect if your contested Shove check against {target} succeeds.
ACTION_HUD.shoveOutcomePrompt2024: Choose the effect if {target} fails the Strength or Dexterity saving throw.
ACTION_HUD.shoveSourceRollUnavailable: Could not read the Athletics roll result, so the Shove defense request was not created.
ACTION_HUD.shoveAwaitDefense: {source} rolled Strength (Athletics): {sourceTotal}. A defense prompt was sent automatically to {target}'s controller to choose Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics). If your Athletics result beats the target's result, the target is {outcome}.
ACTION_HUD.shoveDefenseButtonHint: The target's owner or the GM can click the button below to roll the defense.
ACTION_HUD.shoveDefensePrompt: Choose how {target} defends against the Shove.

ACTION_HUD.shoveResolutionFailed: Could not resolve the Shove defense. Check the console for details.

ACTION_HUD.shoveDefenseFailed: Shove fails: {target} ({skill} {targetTotal}) resists {source}'s Athletics result ({sourceTotal}). No effect is applied.

ACTION_HUD.shoveSavePrompt2024: Choose the saving throw for {target} against DC {dc}.
